listeningStage2Data.translation: 他們決定在大學附近租一間小公寓。

listeningStage3Data.title: Cooking Soup for the Family (為家人煮湯)

articleContent.en: Leo wanted to make delicious soup for his family on Friday evening.
articleContent.zh: 里歐想在週五晚上為家人煮好喝的湯。

articleContent.en: His sister Ella gave her opinion about adding some sweet corn.
articleContent.zh: 他的妹妹艾拉提出意見，建議加一些甜玉米。

articleContent.en: Leo began to chop an onion carefully on the cutting board.
articleContent.zh: 里歐在砧板上小心地切著洋蔥。

articleContent.en: He did not want to be careless and cut his finger.
articleContent.zh: 他不想因為粗心而切到手指。

articleContent.en: Ella helped him arrange the bowls and spoons on the table.
articleContent.zh: 艾拉幫他把碗和湯匙整齊地擺在餐桌上。

articleContent.en: Leo made a promise to cook dinner every weekend.
articleContent.zh: 里歐承諾每個週末都要煮晚餐。

questions.question: Who gave advice about adding sweet corn to the soup?
What did Leo chop carefully on the cutting board?
When did Leo prepare the soup for his family?
Where did Ella arrange the bowls and spoons?
What did Leo promise to do every weekend?
Why did Leo chop the vegetable carefully?
options: Because he did not want to cut his finger
Because the onion was very hard
Because Ella told him to hurry
questions.correct: Because he did not want to cut his finger

listeningStage3Data.title: A New Room for the Club (桌遊社的新空間)

articleContent.en: The board game club needed a new location for their meetings after school.
articleContent.zh: 桌遊社在放學後需要一個新的活動地點。

articleContent.en: The club leader, Max, decided to be independent and solve the problem himself.
articleContent.zh: 社長麥克斯決定獨立自主，自己解決這個問題。

articleContent.en: He asked Mr. Brown if they could rent the empty art room.
articleContent.zh: 他詢問布朗老師他們是否可以租借空置的美術教室。

articleContent.en: The teacher did not refuse his polite request.
articleContent.zh: 老師並沒有拒絕他有禮貌的請求。

articleContent.en: Mr. Brown even gave them a special puzzle game as a gift.
articleContent.zh: 布朗老師甚至送給他們一個特別的謎題遊戲作為禮物。

articleContent.en: All the club members were very happy with the new room.
articleContent.zh: 所有社員都對這間新的教室感到非常開心。

questions.question: Who was the leader of the board game club?
What problem did the club need to solve?
options: Finding a new location for meetings
questions.correct: Finding a new location for meetings

questions.question: When did the board game club usually hold their meetings?
Where was the new space the club asked to use?
What gift did Mr. Brown give to the club?
Why did Max talk to Mr. Brown?
options: Because the club needed a place to meet
Because he wanted to study art
Because he didn't do his homework
questions.correct: Because the club needed a place to meet

listeningStage3Data.title: The Green Cleaner Invention (環保清潔劑發明)

articleContent.en: Amy and Ken worked in the science lab on Wednesday afternoon.
articleContent.zh: 艾咪和肯恩週三下午在自然實驗室做實驗。

articleContent.en: They wanted to invent a safe cleaner made from orange peels.
articleContent.zh: 他們想用柳橙皮發明一種安全的清潔劑。

articleContent.en: Amy stressed that chemical cleaners can poison river water.
articleContent.zh: 艾咪強調化學清潔劑可能會毒害河水。

articleContent.en: They mixed natural oils together to form a soft foam.
articleContent.zh: 他們將天然油脂混合在一起，形成細緻的泡沫。

articleContent.en: The cleaner smelled nice, especially when wiped on wooden desks.
articleContent.zh: 這款清潔劑聞起來很香，特別是擦在木桌上的時候。

articleContent.en: Their science teacher praised them for their creative green idea.
articleContent.zh: 他們的自然老師稱讚了這個充滿創意的環保點子。

questions.question: Who worked together in the science lab?
What did Amy and Ken want to invent?
When did the students work on their science project?
Where did the students do their experiment?
What formed when they mixed the natural oils together?
Why did Amy want to make a natural cleaner?
options: Because chemical cleaners can poison river water
Because she want to spend money
questions.correct: Because chemical cleaners can poison river water

readingStage2Data.title: Snow White and the Evil Queen (白雪公主與壞皇后)
readingStage2Data.article: The evil queen wanted to find the secret {{1}} where Snow White lived. She decided to use a sweet red apple to {{2}} the young princess. The kind girl forgot the dwarfs' warning and was too {{3}} to stay safe. She took a bite of the apple and fell into a deep sleep. The prince found her in the glass coffin and woke her with pure love. Together, they made a promise to protect the magical kingdom forever.

blanks.hint: 表示壞皇后想尋找的秘密「地點、位置」，名詞使用 location。
blanks.translation: 壞皇后想找出白雪公主所居住的秘密地點。

blanks.hint: 表示企圖用毒蘋果「下毒、毒害」，動詞使用 poison。

blanks.translation: 善良的女孩忘記了小矮人們的警告，太過粗心而無法保持安全。

readingStage3Data.title: Snow White and the Evil Queen (白雪公主與壞皇后)

articleContent.en: The evil queen wanted to find the secret location where Snow White lived.
articleContent.zh: 壞皇后想找出白雪公主所居住的秘密地點。

articleContent.en: She decided to use a sweet red apple to poison the young princess.
articleContent.zh: 她決定用一顆甜美的紅蘋果來毒害年輕的公主。

articleContent.en: The kind girl forgot the dwarfs' warning and was too careless to stay safe.
articleContent.zh: 善良的女孩忘記了小矮人們的警告，太過粗心而無法保持安全。

articleContent.en: She took a bite of the apple and fell into a deep sleep.
articleContent.zh: 她咬了一口蘋果，便陷入了沉睡。

articleContent.en: The prince found her in the glass coffin and woke her with pure love.
articleContent.zh: 王子在玻璃棺中找到了她，並用真愛喚醒了她。

articleContent.en: Together, they made a promise to protect the magical kingdom forever.
articleContent.zh: 他們一起許下承諾，將永遠守護這個神奇的王國。

questions.question: Who wanted to harm the young princess with a magic fruit?
What kind of fruit did the queen use in her plan?
Where did the dwarfs place the sleeping princess?
Why did Snow White fall into a deep sleep?
options: Because she ate the poisoned apple
Because the dwarfs asked her to rest
questions.correct: Because she ate the poisoned apple

questions.question: What did the prince and princess promise to do together?
options: Cut down all the apple trees

questions.question: How did the prince wake the princess?

readingStage3Data.title: The Pied Piper of Hamelin (花衣魔笛手)

articleContent.en: The mayor asked the piper to arrange a plan to drive all the rats away from town.
articleContent.zh: 市長請笛手安排一個計畫，將鎮上所有的老鼠趕走。

articleContent.en: The mayor made a strong promise to give the piper ten bags of gold coins.
articleContent.zh: 市長許下鄭重的承諾，要給笛手十袋金幣。

articleContent.en: However, when the rats were gone, the greedy mayor chose to refuse the payment.
articleContent.zh: 然而，當老鼠消失後，貪婪的市長卻選擇拒絕付款。

articleContent.en: The angry piper played a mysterious tune on his magic pipe.
articleContent.zh: 憤怒的笛手用他的魔笛吹奏了一首神秘的曲調。

articleContent.en: All the children in the town followed his sweet music into the mountains.
articleContent.zh: 鎮上所有的孩子都跟隨著他美妙的音樂走進了山中。

articleContent.en: The villagers learned that breaking a deal always brings heavy regret.
articleContent.zh: 村民們學到了毀約總會帶來沉重的悔恨。

questions.question: Who refused to give the piper his promised reward?
What musical instrument did the piper play?
Where did the children follow the piper's music?
Why did the piper take the town's children away?
options: Because the mayor broke his promise
questions.correct: Because the mayor broke his promise

questions.question: What reward did the mayor promise to give the piper?
What important lesson did the villagers learn at the end?
options: Breaking a deal brings heavy regret
questions.correct: Breaking a deal brings heavy regret

readingStage3Data.title: Alice and the Mad Tea Party (愛麗絲與瘋狂茶會)

articleContent.en: Alice sat down at the large tea table under a tree.
articleContent.zh: 愛麗絲坐在樹下一張大茶桌旁。

articleContent.en: The Hatter loved to invent strange riddles that nobody could solve.
articleContent.zh: 瘋帽客喜歡發明沒有人能解開的奇怪謎題。

articleContent.en: The March Hare gave his strange opinion about how time works in Wonderland.
articleContent.zh: 三月兔對仙境中時間的運作方式提出了他古怪的見解。

articleContent.en: They watched the colorful tea bubbles form unusual shapes in the air.
articleContent.zh: 他們看著彩色的茶水氣泡在空中形成不尋常的形狀。

articleContent.en: Alice felt the party was a giant puzzle, especially when the Dormouse fell asleep.
articleContent.zh: 愛麗絲覺得這場茶會是一個巨大的謎團，尤其是當睡鼠睡著的時候。

articleContent.en: She decided to leave the forest and continue her magical adventure alone.
articleContent.zh: 她決定離開森林，獨自繼續她的神奇冒險。

questions.question: Who loved to invent strange riddles at the table?
What did the colorful tea bubbles create in the air?
Where did Alice sit down for the tea party?
options: At the large table under a tree
questions.correct: At the large table under a tree

questions.question: Why did Alice feel the tea party was like a giant puzzle?
options: Because the characters had strange conversations
Because she was looking for a lost key
Because the tea tasted very bad
questions.correct: Because the characters had strange conversations

questions.question: What topic did the March Hare share his opinion on?
options: How to make sweet onion soup

questions.question: What did Alice do at the end of the tea party?
options: She stayed and washed all the tea cups
She fell asleep under the table
